# ValueCafe

> ValueCafe is your roadmap to value investing, helping you master the essentials in the time it takes to finish a cup of coffee. We provide step-by-step guides, financial analysis, and investment strategies based on the philosophies of Warren Buffett and Benjamin Graham.

## Contact
- Website: https://valuecafe.cc
- Email: starchang022@gmail.com
- Contact Page: https://valuecafe.cc/contact

## Services & Learning
- [Beginner's Guide](https://valuecafe.cc/to-beginners): Step-by-step guide to start value investing.
- [Financial Reports](https://valuecafe.cc/statements): Learn to read income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
- [Intrinsic Value](https://valuecafe.cc/intrinsic-value): Methods like DCF, P/E, and P/B ratios.
- [Financial Ratios](https://valuecafe.cc/financial-ratios): Key metrics like ROE, Debt Ratio, and Profit Margin.
- [Investment Philosophy](https://valuecafe.cc/philosophy): Core concepts like Economic Moat, Margin of Safety, and Patience.
- [Legendary Investors](https://valuecafe.cc/legendary): Learn from Warren Buffett, Charlie Munger, and Peter Lynch.
